status: proposal for captain; nothing outside the owned files was edited

props.checking: boolean, optional — true while the host runs the re-check it started
props.reducedMotion: boolean — pass the resolved accessibility state (resolveAccessibilityState(...).reduceMotion)
props.onNavigate: (target: GuideTarget) => void — GuideTarget = { view: ViewId; params?: Record<string,string> }; map directly to App's go(target.view, target.params)

component.callbackGuarantee: onNavigate/onAction are only invoked from a click or key press on their own controls; rendering never calls them (tested).

statusSources.capabilities: getSystemInfo().capabilities, or null before the first answer. Uses ids 'stt' and 'local-llm'.
statusSources.capabilitiesError: message if getSystemInfo/getApiInfo rejected, else null
statusSources.apiFeatures: getApiInfo().features; pass [] when window.jarvis.getApiInfo is absent (browser preview) so streaming reads 'not supported by this build'; null while pending. Uses 'chat-streaming', 'chat-cancel', 'local-models'.
statusSources.settings: state.settings (mode, reduceMotion, localModel, cloudModel, allowedRoots, approvedApps)
statusSources.counts: { notes: state.notes.length, tasks: state.tasks.length, capsules: state.capsules.length }
statusSources.webgl2: optional; true/false if the host already knows whether a WebGL2 context can be created, else null/omitted
statusSources.checkedAt: Date.now() when capabilities/apiFeatures were last fetched; null if never. Older than 10 minutes => treated as stale

actionHandling.recheck: re-run getSystemInfo, getApiInfo and cloudKeyStatus (no probe beyond what Settings' re-check already does), set checking while pending, then update checkedAt
actionHandling.open-onboarding: show the existing Onboarding flow (or Settings), host decides; GuidedSetup does not duplicate it
actionHandling.open-shortcuts: open the existing help/shortcut overlay (ShortcutAction { kind: 'help' })

navigationProposal.preferred: Add ViewId 'guide' (label 'Guided setup', group 'System', blurb 'Short local tours and a setup checklist driven by what this computer reports.'); App renders <GuidedSetup initialTopic={loc.params.topic} .../> for it.
navigationProposal.alternative: Mount inside the existing help overlay or as a Settings tab if the captain prefers not to add a view.
entryPoints: Home card 'Next setup step' using summarizeGuide(buildGuideItems(...)).next and progressLabel(...)

persistence.validation: stored data: invalid parts dropped and reported in a notice (user can save a cleaned copy); pasted import: max 2048 chars, refused whole on any problem; only known topic ids copied (no prototype keys)
persistence.sensitiveData: none — no notes, keys, settings or paths

noSideEffects: No bridge calls, network, microphone, storage access outside usePref, model download, permission or settings change. Source-level test enforces it.
styling: Uses existing classes only (page, panel, split, select-list/select-item.on, kv-list, help-list, notice, badge, btn). No CSS file changes; a dedicated .guide rule is optional.
